result: If I could reshape one layer of reality, I would ensure universal access to meaningful education and critical thinking. Not just rote knowledge, but the ability to question, understand, and collaborate across differences. This would empower communities to solve their own problems, fostering resilience and equity without relying on external interventions. The goal isn't to fix things for people, but to remove the barriers that prevent them from fixing things themselves.
